title: AutoCAD workflows and connector status
description: Explore AutoCAD workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Autodesk

AutoCAD

AutoCAD supports precise 2D drafting and general-purpose 3D design across engineering disciplines.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Revise a dimensioned layout

Start from the controlled drawing, units and reference files. In the intended AutoCAD preview, revise a dimensioned layout; the visible result is revised linework with the changed dimensions called out. Review scale, geometry and drawing standard before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate layers and references

Begin with the agreed layer, block and reference structure. In the intended AutoCAD preview, coordinate layers and references; the visible result is a coordinated sheet view with conflicts exposed. Review layer ownership, reference paths and annotation legibility before accepting or exporting it.

Issue a reviewed drawing set

Use the checked model-space and sheet-space views. In the intended AutoCAD preview, issue a reviewed drawing set; the visible result is a revision-ready drawing package with its change set visible. Review title data, issue scope and plotted output before accepting or exporting it.
